---
title: "Style guide"
description: "Component reference for cwimpy.com — not linked from anywhere, used to iterate on the design system."
page-layout: full
toc: true
toc-location: right
toc-depth: 2
listing: false
search: false
sidebar: false
draft: false
sitemap: false
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          .sg-section { margin: 4rem 0; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-border); }
          .sg-section:first-of-type { border-top: none; padding-top: 0; }
          .sg-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-text-subtle); margin: 1.5rem 0 0.5rem 0; display: block; }
          .sg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1rem 0; }
          .sg-swatch { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-surface); }
          .sg-swatch-chip { width: 100%; height: 56px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
          .sg-swatch-name { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text); }
          .sg-swatch-val  { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--color-text-subtle); }
          .sg-type-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr; align-items: baseline; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-border); }
          .sg-type-row > :first-child { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--color-text-subtle); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; }
          .sg-type-row > :nth-child(2) { line-height: 1.1; margin: 0; }
          .sg-type-row > :nth-child(2) p { margin: 0; }
          .sg-type-row h1, .sg-type-row h2, .sg-type-row h3, .sg-type-row h4 { margin: 0; }
          .sg-token-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px 90px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-border); color: var(--color-text); }
          .sg-token-row .sg-spacer { background: var(--color-accent); height: 14px; opacity: 0.85; border-radius: 2px; }
          .sg-spacer { background: var(--color-accent); height: 14px; opacity: 0.85; border-radius: 2px; }
          .sg-spacing-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
          .sg-spacing-table td { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-border); vertical-align: middle; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; }
          .sg-spacing-table td:first-child { width: 110px; color: var(--color-text); }
          .sg-spacing-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 90px; color: var(--color-text-subtle); }
          .sg-spacing-table code { background: transparent; color: inherit; padding: 0; }
          .sg-radius-box { width: 90px; height: 90px; background: var(--color-bg-muted); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--color-text-subtle); }
          .sg-radius-row { display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
          .sg-note { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-style: italic; margin: 0.5rem 0; }
          .sg-stack > * + * { margin-top: 1.5rem; }

          /* Per-course accent override demo (mirrors what's on PLSC 66003 pages) */
          .course-page.course-plsc66003 {
            --course-accent: #b07a1f;
            --course-accent-soft: rgba(176, 122, 31, 0.10);
            --course-accent-on: #ffffff;
          }
          [data-bs-theme="dark"] .course-page.course-plsc66003,
          .quarto-dark .course-page.course-plsc66003 {
            --course-accent: #d9a44a;
            --course-accent-soft: rgba(217, 164, 74, 0.14);
            --course-accent-on: #1a120a;
          }
        </style>
---

::: {.content-container}

This page is for internal reference only — every component used across the site is rendered here so I can iterate on the design system without hunting through pages. Not linked from the navbar.

# Readings list

<div class="sg-section">

<span class="sg-label">.readings-list — annotated reading list (week pages)</span>

::: {.course-page .course-plsc66003}
::: {.readings-list}
- [Kellstedt and Whitten, *The Fundamentals of Political Science Research*, ch. 1]{.reading-cite}
  [Sets up the empirical-theory loop and why we care about systematic inquiry.]{.reading-note}

- [Wickham et al., *R for Data Science*, ch. 2]{.reading-cite}
  [Tidy data — read carefully. Most everything in the course assumes you've internalized this.]{.reading-note}
:::
:::
